# Authoring reference fixtures

Generated with the actual Blockbench web application, Generic Model codec 5.0,
version 5.2.2, commit `ec0b2827104d0799c153bfb5f867579c0c44652f`.
The fixture geometry and gradient bitmap are original test content. No upstream
application sources, icons, branding or themes are included.

`tests/reference-bb` contains reproducible Playwright scripts. Build the pinned
upstream web application separately (`npm ci`, then its web build), serve its
web output, and set `BLOCKBENCH_URL` (default localhost:29321) and
`BLOCKBENCH_ROOT`. Run the three scripts from the repository root in order:
generate-fixtures, generate-legacy-fixture, generate-gltf-reference.

OBJ exports are actual codec results, not values generated by the C++ code.
The legacy fixture is migrated by the upstream codec into its expected JSON.
The animation glTF is exported at 500 Hz and sampled by the upstream THREE glTF
loader at 0.1-second intervals. 100 Hz has slightly larger error because its
exporter drops close neighboring samples; 500 Hz meets the 0.001-unit test.
